notes: Eden Brothers days_to_maturity is mostly coarse buckets (e.g. 60-90 days); MIgardener DTM is cultivar-specific tags. Prefer MIgardener or Johnny's for exact maturity, Eden Brothers for sun/depth/spacing/zones.
Germination days and Latin names are absent from both vendors' feeds; species-level values live in crop-profiles.json instead.
crop values share the vocabulary of pest-disease-cultivar-seed.json, plus: flower, pumpkin, eggplant, potato, other-herb, other-veg, other-fruit.
Join to crop-profiles.json on crop; join to pest-disease-cultivar-seed.json cultivar_resistance_examples on (crop, cultivar) where names align.
meta.provenance: Scraped from vendor catalogs: Eden Brothers (Shopify structured tags, 802 rows incl. 17 bulb/root) and MIgardener (Shopify tags + prose parse, 808 rows). Field meanings follow each vendor's claims; not independently verified.
